title: BusinessCardScanner Overview Tour
description: AI-powered business card scanner that captures images and extracts contact information automatically using Google's Gemini AI. This tool streamlines the process of digitizing contact details from physical business cards.

popover.title: Welcome to BusinessCardScannerComponent
popover.description: This modal component provides an interface for capturing or uploading business card images and processing them with AI to extract contact information. It's designed to be intuitive for quick data entry.

popover.title: Toggle Camera
popover.description:
Switches between the front and back camera on mobile devices. This helps users find the best angle and lighting for capturing the business card clearly.

When to use: When the current camera view is not optimal for capturing the business card., If you need to switch from a selfie camera to a rear camera or vice-versa.

popover.title: Capture
popover.description:
Takes a photo of the business card using the active camera. This image will then be used for AI processing.

When to use: When you have positioned the business card within the on-screen frame and it is clearly visible., To initiate the photo-taking process after ensuring good lighting and focus.

popover.title: Scan
popover.description:
Processes the captured or uploaded business card image using AI to automatically extract contact information such as name, company, title, phone, email, and address.

When to use: After successfully capturing a new business card image., After uploading an existing business card image from your device.

popover.title: Retake
popover.description:
Discards the currently captured image and reactivates the camera, allowing you to take a new photo of the business card.

When to use: When the previously captured image is blurry, poorly lit, or the card was not fully in frame., If you want to try capturing the card again for better results before scanning.

popover.title: Upload Image
popover.description:
Allows you to select and upload an existing image of a business card from your device's storage instead of taking a new photo.

When to use: When you already have a photo of a business card saved on your computer or mobile device., If your device's camera is not working or you prefer to use a pre-existing image.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of BusinessCardScanner. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
